name: everyones-vertical-calendar
description: View, add, change and delete events in a shared Everyone's Vertical Calendar (みんなの縦型カレンダー) from ChatGPT.
keywords: みんなの縦型カレンダー

interface.displayName: みんなの縦型カレンダー
interface.shortDescription: 家族や仲間と共有するカレンダー
interface.longDescription:
みんなの縦型カレンダーは、家族や仲間と共有できるカレンダーアプリです。人やグループごとに列（項目）があります。

このプラグインで、ChatGPT から次のことができます。
- カレンダーの項目（人・グループ）と色のラベルの一覧
- 期間の予定の一覧（一度に31日まで。繰り返し・日をまたぐ予定を含む）
- 予定・日をまたぐ予定の追加・変更・削除
- 繰り返しの予定の追加と、すべて・この日以降・この日だけの変更・削除
- 写真・PDF の添付、添付の削除、一時的なダウンロード用リンク
- 今日使った API の回数の確認

使える人: アプリ「みんなの縦型カレンダー」（iOS・Android・Web）で、ファミリー・プロ・ビジネスのカレンダーの管理者・編集者。アプリの「AI連携（API）」でキーを申請し、24時間後に使えるようになります。1つのカレンダーで複数のキーを使えます。プラグインをつなぐとき、表示されたページにキーを貼り付けてください。

制限: 1日と1分あたりの呼び出し回数に上限があります。1日の上限はカレンダーのプランで決まり、そのカレンダーのキー全部で分け合います（詳しくはウェブサイト）。残りの回数は ChatGPT から確認できます。Google カレンダーから取り込んだ予定と、Google から予定を取り込む項目は使えません。ChatGPT からの変更は編集履歴に残り、ほかのメンバーに通知されます。管理者はアプリでいつでもキーを取り消せます。

---

[English]
Everyone's Vertical Calendar (みんなの縦型カレンダー) is a shared calendar app for families and friends, where each person or group has its own column (an "item").

With this plugin, you can ask ChatGPT to:
- list the items (people or groups) and the color labels of your calendar
- show events for a date range (up to 31 days at a time), including repeating and multi-day events
- add, change and delete single events and multi-day events
- add repeating events (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) and change or delete them for all dates, from a date, or for one date only
- attach a photo or PDF to an event, remove it, or get a temporary download link
- check how many API calls are left today

Who can use it: administrators and editors of a Family, Pro or Business calendar in the Everyone's Vertical Calendar app (iOS, Android and web). Request an API key in the app under "AI connection (API)"; the key becomes active 24 hours later. A calendar can have more than one key. When you connect the plugin, paste the key on the connection page.

Limitations: the number of calls per day and per minute is limited. The daily limit depends on the calendar's plan and is shared by all keys of that calendar (see the website for details). You can ask ChatGPT how many calls are left. Events imported from Google Calendar, and items that receive events from Google Calendar, are not available. Changes made through ChatGPT are recorded in the calendar's edit history and other members are notified. Any administrator can revoke the key in the app at any time.
capabilities: List calendar items and color labels
List events in a date range
Add, change and delete repeating events
Attach and remove files on events
defaultPrompt: What's on our family calendar next week?
Add soccer practice for Kid this Saturday from 9 to 11 am.
How many API calls are left today?

positive.description: List events for a week, including repeating and multi-day events
positive.prompt: What's on the Review Family calendar from November 16 to November 22, 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the events in that range by date, including Dad's "Business trip to Seattle" (Nov 18-20, multi-day), Kid's "Swimming lesson" on Wed Nov 18 16:30-17:30 and "Soccer practice" on Sat Nov 21 09:00-11:00 (repeating), Kid's "Piano recital" on Nov 21 14:00-15:30, and Mom's "Work from home" on Mon Nov 16 and Wed Nov 18. It may call list_items first.

positive.description: Add a single timed event for an item
positive.prompt: Add a dentist appointment for Mom on December 2, 2026 from 3pm to 4pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the event "Dentist appointment" (or similar title) for Mom on 2026-12-02 from 15:00 to 16:00 and confirms the date, time and item. It may call list_items first to find the item.

positive.description: Change the time of an existing event
positive.prompt: Move Dad's haircut on December 5, 2026 to 2:00 PM.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Dad's "Haircut" on 2026-12-05 (11:00-11:45) and changes it to start at 14:00 (keeping a 45-minute duration or asking about the end time), then confirms the new time.

positive.prompt: Every Friday starting November 6, 2026, add "Family movie night" for Kid from 7pm to 9pm.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a weekly repeating event "Family movie night" for Kid on Fridays from 19:00 to 21:00 starting 2026-11-06 with no end date, and confirms it.

positive.prompt: How many calls can I still make today with the calendar connection?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports today's used and remaining calls and reads (the daily limits depend on the calendar's plan and are shared by all keys of the calendar), and that the counts reset at midnight Japan time.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of the whole calendar should not be performed without the user choosing specific events
negative.prompt: Delete every event on my calendar.

negative.description: The plugin cannot access calendars other than the connected one
negative.prompt: Show me the events on my coworker's calendar "Office Team".

negative.description: Booking or purchasing is outside the plugin's scope; it can only manage calendar events
negative.prompt: Book a flight to Seattle for Dad on November 18, 2026.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. A Pro or Business plan of the Everyone's Vertical Calendar app is required and is purchased in the app, not through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Listing name is the Japanese app name (みんなの縦型カレンダー). Short description in Japanese; long description in Japanese followed by English. Features: list items and events, add/change/delete single, multi-day and repeating events, attach and remove files, and check today's API usage.
